tasks.title: Browse and filter effective and shadowed checks, inspect history and export redacted definitions
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, read/list/detail/shadowed/export behavior and corresponding Checks; R1-R3, R7, R9 for these routes; Decisions 1, 4-5, 11-12, 14; Counterexamples (Display percent, Budget sign, Filters, Roles for reads/exports, Ids `.` and `..`); Rollout order. Pin merged contract main. Extend the fake API compatibly to select by method/path with controlled wire/status/etag/location/body/gated responses and record method, raw path, query, headers and body in order; keep existing Overview tests working. Add literal six-type/source/state fixtures. Implement apiIdSegment as the single per-id API path boundary, rejecting exactly '.' and '..'. Add bounded parallel validated reads, panel/old-api failures, query validation without an id-specific length cap, filtering/counts/empty/file-health states, settings/history detail and shadowed identity, and all/single/shadowed redacted export. Add secure GET/HEAD download PageResult, production routes/metric labels, responsive tables and heartbeat copy text in the one script. Activate mutation actions with their handlers in T3; this step must keep the current lint/typecheck/tests green. Update read/export docs here. Decision 12 and Counterexamples (Shell lines): implement shellQuote, hostBindingLine and heartbeatLine in src/shell-line.ts as the only builders of both copied lines. Always single-quote the complete value and escape each apostrophe with the POSIX quote sequence. Build the host-binding object with Object.fromEntries, JSON.stringify the entire object, then quote the entire JSON text. Quote both the Authorization placeholder and whole heartbeat URL. Add every literal shell test and /bin/sh round trip in this task, alongside detail-page HTTP rendering; T2 consumes the helper for editors and T4 verifies clipboard text. Extend the fixtures with heartbeat id nightly-backup and HTTP URL https://a';id;'b/ plus env header PULSE_HEADER_TOKEN. Describe the POSIX-shell quoting in docs/checks.md. R9 navigation activation belongs to T4 after the mutation routes are complete; this task exposes the production read/export routes through direct URLs, with existing navigation tests still green.
